selection_rules: exact title must equal Delisting of <EXACT_SYMBOL> Perpetual Contract after whitespace normalization
primary body must exist and be a nonempty list
primary body text is extracted deterministically from descendant text leaves in document order
normalized primary body length must be at least 120 characters
article region is exact title plus normalized primary body
if secondary consistency path exists, extract it with the same algorithm and require normalized body SHA256 equality
secondary path absence does not authorize fallback and does not invalidate an otherwise valid primary path
primary path failure does not authorize another candidate path; event becomes BODY_SOURCE_UNRESOLVED/REVIEW
no page-specific path selection or adaptive fallback is allowed
